notes.title: New minigame up to 1.000 players!
notes.content:
This game is designed to find the person who knows you best as a streamer. More than 100 questions focused on you and your personal tastes.

[b]This game allows up to 1,000 players and is ideal for giveaways or contests where true fans have more chances to win.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/e9968c184f6364b7e8441e4225eb5f87051a1506.png[/img]

There are questions of all kinds to suit your interests or the mood you are in that day:
- Innocents.
- Daily routine.
- Deeper thoughts.
- Geek opinions.
- And even the most absurd ones!

You can select only the categories that fit your content, create your own custom question packs, or ask your followers to make a pack for you.
You can create a quiz with questions about your latest project or your favorite series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/e5c8308eae31a42a770bac0e5ddf8a022aab217b.png[/img]

notes.title: Dungeon raid game has been updated.
notes.content:
Smol but highly relevant update in Kukoro dungeons!
😫Nerf: Berserk & Taunter. 
😎Buff: Rogue & Bard. 
🏆!Champion command: available for the champion on any stream. 
🎯!Focus command: available to optimize your strategies.
📅Highscores are now reseted monthly.

[h3]😎 Roles[/h3]

When a viewer reaches level 20, he can unlock a new role. This roles force your abilities to point a specific type of gameplay, like healing or defense.

Berserk: Based on empowering first and last hits has been nerfed.
Taunter: Based on first hit and running away has been nerfed.
Rogue: Based on crit. attacks has been buffed. (Crits. are amazing to break into defensive enemies)
Bard: Based on healing your team and yourself has been buffed.


[h3]🏆!Champion command[/h3]

When a streamer defeats the last champion, he will place himself as the new champion for the next contendants. But now !champion command has been added.

This command allows the champion to get into others' stream as a new enemy by typing !champion in their chat and flex his power.

[h3]🎯!Focus command[/h3]

Now all viewers with the game can change their targets before the game starts. This will allow you to focus your abilities to the most relevant enemy or distribute your team objectives into a more strategic gameplay.

If you have crit. abilities, you can change your objective to a defensive enemy like a Gargoyle. If one of your teammates reduces agility, face him into bats, the quickest enemy.

This command is only available before the game starts.


[h3]MORE INFO[/h3]
[url=https://heynaugames.com/how-to-master-dungeon-raid-game-kukoro-stream-chat-games]https://heynaugames.com/how-to-master-dungeon-raid-game-kukoro-stream-chat-games[/url]

notes.title: EMPOWERING STREAMERS' DISCOVERY
notes.content:
Kukoro has always prided itself on being a community-based game. That's why we have recently implemented some changes, such as disabling the AFK mode in the Kukoro category, in an effort to [b]maintain a cleaner and more active Twitch category for all viewers.[/b]
With this, we have noticed that it can be challenging at times to find online streamers across different categories, so we have decided to create a 🌟[b]new discovery panel[/b]🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/573a02a2afd423abb2507f01a034135c601fc834.png[/img]


[h2]NEW FEATURES OF THE PANEL:[/h2]
Our intention with this new panel is for you to discover channels where you can play Kukoro. To achieve this, we aim to enhance the following features:
[list]
[*]📸 Prioritize players who are [b]currently live[/b].
[*]🌍 [b]Highlight their language[/b] and viewer count so you can choose according to your preferences.
[*]👩‍❤️‍👩 Show [b]how many times you've played together[/b], encouraging you to repeat if the experience was positive.
[/list]
📆 Additionally, you can see all the streamers who have played in the last 24 hours in case you missed any you want to follow for upcoming games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/c7b5cf15459fbe602f5c5262deaee4aecc88ac53.png[/img]


[h2]GOTTA CATCH 'EM ALL![/h2]
All this system, is gamified with the new [b]Favorites column where you can add up to 20 of your favorite streamers[/b], or those in your unattainable top 😎
If you want to catch the trendiest streamer, you must be attentive to add them on the same day they play, turning the biggest streamers into something like collectible creatures 🦄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/3f9a2d1e501cd466470b497e6ba1a37e3025cfc4.png[/img]


[h2]WHAT DO WE WANT TO ACHIEVE WITH THIS NEW LAYOUT?[/h2]
The main purpose of this panel is to [b]grow the Kukoro community[/b] by facilitating social connections 💞
We hope that featuring your favorite streamers [b]will help them gain discovery[/b] by other Kukoro players, creating larger and healthier communities. This, in turn, [b]may encourage more streamers from various languages to stream the game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/79dfd41c4f66d3a3019fbae1790abeaa336b85f7.png[/img]


[h2]WE ARE LISTENING[/h2]
Whether you are a viewer or a streamer, we would love to hear your feedback on this feature. It was relatively improvised as there are many things beyond our control, so we would appreciate your input if you feel something is awkward or inconvenient to use. [b]It would also be great if you notice any changes in your audience, whether it increases📈 or decreases📉 when you play Kukoro[/b], so we can work on enhancing specific aspects of these new features.

[b]Thank you very much for continuing to play Kukoro!
Nau[/b]😁

notes.title: NEW EMOTE SYSTEM
notes.content:
Now you can use your own emoticons from any channel you are subscribed to or the free ones offered by Twitch. This will give you the opportunity to select better emotions at the perfect moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/6b3e9019c15ca13a30ab03fd36205a3ec77b7f04.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/4fed72608083612f96be6d69da8a8a955bb9365e.gif[/img]

Type [b]"!emote + the emote you want"[/b] to display them on the screen. You can test it by copying this message in your chat while you are in game:

[i]!emote VoteYea[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/0c5ee51541d2a14e0f53f98e9a2b1595aad51401.gif[/img]


[b]Use them everytime you want to highlight your reactions while playing, it will be fun![/b]

notes.title: Find the cursed pattern!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/3ad23af28295dc54275c6af90b24d106d864acdc.png[/img]

Up to 100 players can compete in a mini pattern search game.

During 5 rounds, players must find the indicated pattern on the board - but beware! There can only be one person on each tile, so the fastest will get it.

Each round the patterns will be more complex and there will be fewer squares available, so only the most clever players will be able to save themselves.

Remember that you can also play this mini-game in automatic mode while you are away =)

notes.title: Kukoro has now up to 14 Twitch chat mini-games
notes.content:
Whether you are a Streamer or a Viewer, Kukoro is for you. Collect skins, pets, dances, emotions and use them in your favorite streams. And always have a reserved spot in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/0912e4d44cb3a4c975dfc67575210eec1f394d0a.png[/img]

Kukoro already has more than 14 different mini-games to interact with your audience. All these games are based on basic principles:

- Highlight players as unique individuals, creating a healthier and closer community.
- Sense of progress, unlocking new skins, pets and customization for both the Streamer and the viewers who own the game.

- No randomness. This is a game: skill and decision making are a fundamental part of it.

- Mission system for those who want a challenge, where you can unlock unique skins and pets by playing in your stream or anyone else's thanks to account linking.

- Referral system: Kukoro is a very low priced game that tries to be accessible to all viewers, not just the streamer. If you get your audience to buy the game, you will receive a unique and personalized look for you and your audience. A tribe skin designed by you!

notes.title: Egg spawning has been increased!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/09b3d52aa29b7d0a64b2f0d61bc9e75d3ef058dd.png[/img]

The egg system offers players the opportunity to obtain new pets. As Kukoro is still under development, this system is constantly changing balance.

To get a pet you just have to touch an egg with your character, either playing as a streamer or playing as a viewer in another live stream. But the challenge is not only to be the first to touch it, but also to be able to keep the egg for 2 minutes until it hatches.

Previously, these eggs were generated every 30 minutes. With a 5% chance of appearing for each premium player who had entered the game. Thus, if 20 different players have played with you, the chance of an egg appearing in that session is 100%.

1 player = 5% of 1 egg every 30 minutes.
10 player = 50% of 1 egg every 30 minutes.
20 player = 100% of 1 egg every 30 minutes.
30 player = 150% > 100% (1egg) + 50% (2egg) every 30 minutes.

This probability is reset every time you close your game. A maximum of one egg may appear at the beginning of each mini-game.

[b]With the new update, egg emergence has been reduced to 20 minutes. [/b]Making the eggs appear more frequently.

Remember that this is not the only way to get pets. If you complete all the missions of the same mini-game, you will directly get a special pet.

Contact to [i]kukoro@heynaugames.com[/i] when you reach the goal and I will develop an [b]EXCLUSIVE SKIN which can only be accessed by you and your referrals.[/b]

You will be able to invade other channels with your audience wearing the exclusive uniform of your channel!

notes.title: AutoPlay-mode is now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38940803/ed2d179100e5f8620244c9282b06cafd464e8c18.png[/img]

We already had some game modes like “The Perfect Warrior” and “Training Zone” to leave your stream afk while you had to go to the supermarket or take a nap.

But now we have taken it to another level named Auto-Play mode. If you enable this option, your viewers will be able to play Kukoro without you in the stream. They will be able to choose what to play themselves via chat and start the games at any time. You can check it out by checking the option at the bottom of the Games panel.

This mode is only available for those mini-games that do not directly require the streamer to play.
